newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy parliament approves first article of budget.
newsitem.headline: Italy parliament approves first article of budget.

text.p: Italy's Chamber of Deputies (lower house) on Tuesday approved the first article of the government's proposed 1997 budget.

The article, relating to health care, is among 70 articles in the overall budget, which aims to cut a total of 62.5 trillion lire ($42 billion) from Italy's projected deficit and bring the country close to European monetary union.
The Chamber, where Prime Minister Romano Prodi's center-left coalition depends on the support of the hard-left Communist Refoundation, has until November 14 to complete voting on the budget.
It then passes to the Senate, where the government coalition holds a majority of seats.
